recommendedInformationArchitecture.workspace: Project · Scenario · Version/no-Version · draft state; full details on one disclosure.
recommendedInformationArchitecture.rfContext: Single/Network · cell count · technology · frequency; power and radius in secondary RF details where space is constrained.
recommendedInformationArchitecture.status: Operation readiness/error plus CURRENT/STALE/HISTORICAL/UNAVAILABLE/UNSUPPORTED and short source Run when applicable.
recommendedInformationArchitecture.primaryAction: Run Sector/Evaluate Network with unchanged semantics and existing Plan/Simulate visibility.
recommendedInformationArchitecture.resultMetrics: Results panel and active-layer map legend; do not keep a separate global metric card.

lineageContract: Without opening a deep panel, users can answer which Project, Scenario, Version/draft, result state, and short source Run are active. The detail disclosure is for full IDs and provenance, not basic identity.
persistenceContract: An immutable Saved Version is distinct from a browser-local autosaved draft. Do not make 'Unsaved changes' appear to mean unsaved local data when only Version creation is pending.
primaryActionFinding: The action is a plan-level command placed in the global bar for Plan/Simulate tools. Keep the established Run Sector/Evaluate Network mode-aware labels and required-cell readiness. Tool-specific analysis/reference/report actions remain in their tool and retain one clear local primary action.
